'''Jaymis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed on [[Voss]], where under the behest of [[Nim-Sa]] he asked an Imperial for assistance in dealing with the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].
